title: Aoyagi Toya — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, good morning.
Sorry, but would you mind coming over to Class B for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Morning, Toya... And Akito?
Dude, you're in the wrong class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'm not.
Toya asked me to tag along.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Perfect.
I was just hoping to speak with both of you. It's about these...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
Hm? They look homemade.
Did you bake these, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Care to have some?
There's no way I can eat all of these on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My mother doesn't cook very often, but during special occasions, like my birthday, she'll bake cookies for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I don't actually know why, but my father and brothers also just seemed to believe it's what our family does...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I knew they were only for special occasions, but before I realized it, I was asking her to make them whenever. I just seemed to fall in love with them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you sure about sharing these with us? They mean a lot to you, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's my birthday present and they mean quite a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'd rather not have them all to myself or let them go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it...
In that case, I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone in 1-B!
Is Toya here?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
It's them!
The Weirdo Wombo Combo!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome, you're here too.
That saves us the trouble of finding you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Toya, good morning!
And happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. How long have I known you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll be putting on a special show for you during lunch on the rooftop today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Rui and Nene will also be a part of it, so I'm sure you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll be looking forward to it.
Thank you both very much, Tsukasa, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're very welcome.
You're welcome to join us as well, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. The more the merrier when it comes to having an audience!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
Well, if Toya's going, then I guess I'll go too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
We were just talking about the show we'll be doing during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard that you'll be a part of it as well, Kusanagi. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They asked me to be in it, but I'm just gonna be in the chorus for a bit. You really don't have to thank me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, have any of you seen Mizuki anywhere? If you don't mind, I was hoping to invite them along as well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no way Akiyama's gonna be here this early.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At this point, Aoyagi, you and Mizuki are reasonably well acquainted. Not inviting Mizuki to celebrate with us may come back to haunt me later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yeah, Akiyama does like these sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. During the School Festival, Akiyama seemed to genuinely enjoy the show Tsukasa and his classmates did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt Akiyama would want to miss out on a special show like this one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, not what I was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I'll try letting Akiyama know about the show. Fortunately, we've swapped contact information before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll send Mizuki an invite to join us for your birthday celebration as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Would you all like some cookies?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you're here!
Would you mind waiting? We have just a bit more left to set up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I received a reply saying that Akiyama should be here in time for the show, so soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me, Toya!
Also, happy birthday! Here's your present!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
A box crammed full of an assortment of cookies♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate it, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena's the one who actually told me.
We were just both talking about taking a quick nap when Toya and Rui sent me their invites.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I told Ena that it's your birthday today, Toya, she said how Li'l Bro here mentioned something about you liking cookies! I'm glad she was right!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to repay you for your gift, but this is all I have at the moment. Would you like a cookie?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? These look homemade. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My mother made them, but I want to take this opportunity to share them with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! In that case, I'll gladly have some♪ Wait, where's An? I figured that she'd be here too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we tried inviting her, but she has a hall monitor meeting right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. No offense against Shiraishi, but I chose this time because of this tidbit of information.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Does this mean you're gonna do something crazy or dangerous...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're all set up! Let's get this show on the road!
